children: Alvopetro Energy Ltd. (V.ALV) Hit a 52-Week High of $11.40. Alvopetro CEO Corey Ruttan spoke to Proactive's Stephen Gunnion about the company's latest Mannville acreage acquisition in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin, which adds 14 net sections and increases the company's drilling inventory by approximately 75%.
Glacier Media Inc (T.GVC) Hit a 52-Week High of 38 cents. No news stories available today.

Hemlo Mining Corp. (T.HMMC) Hit a 52-Week High of $8.32. This week, Hemlo announced additional assay results from its ongoing drilling program designed to support future mineral resource growth across the Hemlo Gold Mine, located near Marathon, Ontario.

Mineros SA (T.MSA) Hit a 52-Week High of $9.03. In July, Mineros adopted a formal Strategic Gold Reserve Policy under its Investment Management Policy. The Policy establishes physical gold bullion as a core treasury asset of the Company.
RESAAS Services Inc. (RSS.V) Hit a 52-Week High of 57 cents. RESAAS announced that it has been invited to present at the Annual Smallcap Discoveries Conference in Vancouver on September 29.
South Star Battery Metals Corp. (V.STS) Hit a 52-Week High of 26 cents. No news stories available today.

Talon Metals Corp. (T.TLO) Hit a 52-Week High of $10.74. Talon announced that, following its evaluation of potential processing pathways for material from the Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project in central Minnesota, the Company has selected its existing Humboldt Mill in Michigan as the processing location. As a result, Talon will not be advancing the construction of the previously proposed Beulah Minerals Processing Facility in Mercer County, North Dakota.

Tenaz Energy Corp (T.TNZ) Hit a 52-Week High of $74.00. During the last quarter, the company brought four (1.9 net) wells on production that were drilled in Q1 2026 and participated in the drilling of two (0.9 net) development wells. In addition, Tenaz conducted or participated in seasonal maintenance on the L2, L9 and N05 platforms, along with planned turnaround activity at the Den Helder plant.
Total Energy Services Inc. (T.TOT) Hit a 52-Week High of $35.06. No news stories available today.

title: Alvopetro, Glacier, Hemlo Lead Short List of Stocks at 52-Week Highs
